_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Mchezaji anazunguka kwenye {width}x{height} grid.
Wewe ni mchezaji {player_id}. Hatua halali: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' au w/s/a/d.
Lengo: kushinda wengine wote. Milia ni hatari; kugonga ukuta kunaua; kukutana kwa kichwa kunaua wote wawili.

board.after_moves: Chizavu ha kupwa cha kutambuka ni mashimbu amwe: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Mutu yoze te akulinga {player_id} afwile ha kusa yiteli yize yapwile ya kuhona.

outcome.survived_win: Mutu yoze te akulinga jila {player_id} ya mwono; akwa-kusa ni waze apwile mu chihanda cha ndeke.
outcome.all_crashed: Akwa-kuzomboka eswe yafwa ha shimbu limwe.
outcome.turn_limit: Muze muchikolo cha kukinga chizavu chinakumanuka, yoze walamwina chinji.
